quarterly_data.signal: Arm's Q1 FYE27 shareholder letter (6-K): annualized contract value (ACV) was $1,732 million at the end of Q1 FYE27 versus $1,528 million a year earlier (+13%); revenue from related parties was $388 million in the quarter versus $328 million (revenue from external customers $901 million vs $725 million). Beginning with Q1 FYE27 Arm no longer reports remaining performance obligations or the number of extant Arm Total Access and Arm Flexible Access licenses in its shareholder letter, saying they have become less relevant to its growth with the extension of its business into production silicon.
quarterly_data.figure: ACV $1,732 million (+13% YoY); related-party revenue $388 million
